name: contract-expectation-diagnostics
goal: Preserve the original error when an authored example unexpectedly fails.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An invalid tested revision caused the audio method case to report only Example unexpectedly failed; its original validation error was absent.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing example-initialized case asserted only a generic failure message, so it never required the unexpected error message or cause to survive.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test a819be0cd8 failed in c821694fe96f because the original error message and cause were missing.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: f3a574274a preserves the unexpected thrown value and message; 73ea1d2d48 simplifies the formatter.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged case passed at 73ea1d2d48 in 78b689e81bef; mutant 4a3d35249b36 failed and restored 22c75953df74 passed.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
